title: Poljak
comment: Poljak — Classic reference: B Poljak, Some methods of speeding up the convergence of iteration methods, 1964. Introduces momentum methods to speed up gradient descent schemes. https://distill.pub/2017/momentum/

title: Moreau Bregman
comment: Moreau Bregman — Moreau's decomposition generalizes the orthogonal decomposition to general functions. It can also be generalized beyond Euclidean space using Bregman divergences in place of Euclidean distance. https://hal.archives-ouvertes.fr/hal-01076974/document
alt_text: Moreau Bregman. Moreau's decomposition generalizes the orthogonal decomposition to general functions. It can also be generalized beyond Euclidean space using Bregman divergences in place of Euclidean distance.

title: Scale Space Filtering
comment: Scale Space Filtering — Classic reference: A Witkin, Scale-space filtering, 1984. Introduces (with J. Koenderink) the notion of scale space, i.e., the multi-scales analysis of signals and images, which is at the heart of many vision architectures. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scale_space

title: Sibson
comment: Sibson — Classic reference: R Sibson, A vector identity for the Dirichlet tessellation, 1980. Defines natural neighbor interpolation, generalizing piecewise linear interpolation to higher dimensions. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Natural_neighbor_interpolation
alt_text: Sibson. Classic reference: R Sibson, A vector identity for the Dirichlet tessellation, 1980. Defines natural neighbor interpolation, generalizing piecewise linear interpolation to higher dimensions.

title: Hausdorff
comment: Hausdorff — The space of compact sets in a metric space is a compact set for the Hausdorff metric. Hausdorff convergence is weak and does not preserve topology, dimension, length, or path-connectedness. It preserves connectedness and convexity. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hausdorff_distance
alt_text: Hausdorff. The space of compact sets in a metric space is a compact set for the Hausdorff metric. Hausdorff convergence is weak and does not preserve topology, dimension, length, or path-connectedness. It preserves connectedness and convexity.

title: Proj Grad

title: N Ellipses
comment: N Ellipses — N-ellipses generalize ellipses with n foci. Spectrahedra (hence convex) algebraic curves of degree less than 2^n. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/N-ellipse

title: Medial Axis
comment: Medial Axis — The medial axis (also known as skeleton) is the set of points where the distance is not smooth. Used as a shape descriptor in computer vision. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Medial_axis

title: Qr Algo

title: Stable Fluids
